routes.description: Log-potential master identity quoted verbatim in research/MISSION.md (foundational assumption #3, Wave-2 finding): eps''(x) = (1/pi) * integral g(t) * ln[cos(pi t/2L)/|sin(pi(x-t)/2L)|] dt, collapsed to an exact finite sum for atomic g. No FFT, no grid, no smoothing.
routes.independence_from_source: Does not call tmm_helper.ht_derivative or any FFT/Hilbert-transform machinery at all; pure closed-form arithmetic over the 20 atoms.

routes.strength: Rank 2/3 (different discretization of the production pipeline)
routes.description: Atomic measure realized as a smoothed decreasing staircase (erf transitions of variable width s) on a cell-centered non-duplicating grid, pushed through tmm_helper.ht_derivative (the DiHiTI implementation named in the dispatch brief). Swept N in {4001,6000,8192,16001} and s in {0.02,0.01,0.005,0.002}.
routes.independence_from_source: Grid convention (cell-centered, no linspace endpoint duplication) and smoothing scheme chosen fresh per PROTOCOL.md warnings, not copied from any project script.

control.description: Single balanced atomic pair at t=-a,+b with M1=0 enforced is known analytically to be passive iff a+b<=1 (window half-width L=1). Swept a+b from 0.6 to 1.4 (symmetric and asymmetric pairs) through both routes.
control.result: PASSED - both routes reproduce the a+b<=1 threshold exactly (PASSIVE below, min~0 at boundary, GAIN above with correctly growing magnitude).
